# Saatchi Art

> > Saatchi Art is a global online art marketplace connecting collectors with emerging and established artists, offering original paintings, photography, and sculpture with personalized curation and advisory services.

Saatchi Art operates as a digital art platform featuring thousands of artists from around the world, including emerging talents from the United States, Poland, Austria, and the United Kingdom. The platform combines e-commerce functionality with art advisory services, curated exhibitions, and artist portfolios to facilitate direct sales between artists and collectors.

## Key Topics

- Emerging Artists

## Core Marketplace

- [Saatchi Art Homepage](https://www.saatchiart.com): Buy original paintings, photos & art from emerging artists worldwide
- [Curated Deals](https://www.saatchiart.com/curated-deals): Weekly curator-approved artworks at limited-time reduced prices

## Art Advisory & Curation Services

- [Art Advisory](https://www.saatchiart.com/artadvisory): Private art curator service for personalized art acquisition advice and collection building

## Digital Exhibitions

- [Afterglow Digital Exhibition](https://www.saatchiart.com/shows/afterglow): Contemporary still-life artworks curated online in a themed digital exhibition

## Featured Artists

- [Murray Taylor](https://www.saatchiart.com/account/profile/283377): Abstract painter from Baltimore, Maryland specializing in contemporary works
- [Tomek Mistak](https://www.saatchiart.com/account/profile/426893): Contemporary acrylic painter from Poland with distinctive artistic style
- [Mark Rauschberg](https://www.saatchiart.com/account/profile/921343): Impressionist painter from Vienna, Austria focusing on classical techniques
- [Monica Vitorino](https://www.saatchiart.com/account/profile/1978509): Watercolor figurative artist from London creating expressive human studies
